muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿الحمد لله الذي له ما في السماوات وما في الأرض﴾: (الحمد): mubtadaʾ (subject); (لله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; (الذي): a relative noun, an adjective. (له): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (ما): a relative noun, the postponed mubtadaʾ; (في السماوات): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. (وما في الأرض): conjoined to ﴿ما في السماوات﴾; and the clause ﴿له ما في السماوات ...﴾ is the ṣila of (الذي), a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وله الحمد في الآخرة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (له): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (الحمد): postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); (في الآخرة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the fronted khabar or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from (الحمد).
﴿وهو الحكيم الخبير﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (هو): mubtadaʾ (subject); (الحكيم): first khabar (predicate); (الخبير): second khabar of ﴿هو﴾.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿يعلم ما يلج في الأرض وما يخرج منها﴾: (يعلم): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "He" (هو), referring to Allah the Exalted; (ما): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause ﴿يلج﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position. (في الأرض): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يلج﴾; (ما يخرج): conjoined to ﴿ما يلج﴾; (منها): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يخرج﴾; and the clause ﴿يعلم ما يلج ...﴾ is a third khabar (predicate) of ﴿هو﴾, or a ḥāl (circumstantial), or resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وما ينزل من السماء وما يعرج فيها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (ما ينزل): conjoined to ﴿ما يلج﴾; (من السماء): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ينزل﴾; (ما يعرج): conjoined to ﴿ما يلج﴾; (فيها): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يعرج﴾.
﴿وهو الرحيم الغفور﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial; (هو): mubtadaʾ (subject); (الرحيم): first khabar (predicate); (الغفور): second khabar.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿وقال الذين كفروا لا تأتينا الساعة﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (قال): past verb; (الذين): fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), a clause with no grammatical position. (لا): negating; (تأتينا): imperfect verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الساعة): fāʿil; and the clause ﴿وقال الذين كفروا...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿قل بلى وربي لتأتينكم﴾: (قل): imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (بلى): a particle of reply, cancelling the negation in their saying ﴿لا تأتينا الساعة﴾; the wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive; (ربي): a noun in the genitive by the wāw of the oath, and the yāʾ of the speaker is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (لتأتينكم): the lām occurs in the response to the oath; (تأتينكم): imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "it" (هي).
﴿عالم الغيب لا يعزب عنه مثقال ذرة في السماوات ولا في الأرض﴾: (عالم): an adjective of ﴿ربي﴾, or a badal (substitute); (الغيب): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿لا يعزب﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿ربي﴾; (عنه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يعزب﴾; (مثقال): fāʿil (agent); (ذرة): muḍāf ilayhi; (في السماوات): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿مثقال ذرة﴾ or a ḥāl from it; (ولا في الأرض): conjoined to ﴿في السماوات﴾.
﴿ولا أصغر من ذلك ولا أكبر إلا في كتاب مبين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لا): negating; (أصغر): mubtadaʾ (subject); (من ذلك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أصغر﴾; (ولا أكبر): conjoined to ﴿أصغر﴾; (إلا): particle of restriction; (في كتاب): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of (أصغر); (مبين): an adjective. Alternatively, ﴿ولا أصغر﴾ and ﴿ولا أكبر﴾ are conjoined to (مثقال), and on this view ﴿إلا في كتاب﴾ is an emphasis of the negation in ﴿لا يعزب﴾, as though He said: "but rather it is in a clear Book."

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿ليجزي الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات﴾: the lām is for causation; (يجزي): imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) (أن) after the lām, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "He" (هو); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the imperfect verb is genitive by the lām, and the lām of causation and its genitive are attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تأتينكم) or to His saying ﴿لا يعزب﴾; (الذين): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), a clause with no grammatical position. (عملوا): past verb, and the wāw of the group is the fāʿil; (الصالحات): mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ﴿عملوا الصالحات﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾.
﴿أولئك لهم مغفرة ورزق كريم﴾: (أولئك): mubtadaʾ (subject); (لهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of ﴿مغفرة﴾; (مغفرة): postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause ﴿لهم مغفرة﴾ is the khabar of (أولئك); (رزق): conjoined to (مغفرة); (كريم): an adjective.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t: ﴿والذين سعوا في آياتنا معاجزين أولئك لهم عذاب من رجز أليم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (الذين): mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿سعوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), a clause with no grammatical position. (في آياتنا): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سعوا﴾, on the assumption of an implied muḍāf, i.e. "in invalidating Our signs by attacking them or describing them as sorcery and poetry." (معاجزين): ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in ﴿سعوا﴾; (أولئك): mubtadaʾ; (لهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (عذاب): postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿لهم عذاب﴾ is the khabar of (أولئك), and the clause ﴿أولئك لهم عذاب﴾ is the khabar of ﴿الذين﴾; (من رجز): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of (عذاب); (أليم): a second adjective of (عذاب); and the clause ﴿والذين سعوا...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿ويرى الذين أوتوا العلم الذي أنزل إليك من ربك هو الحق﴾: the wāw is resumptive and (يرى) is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); or the wāw is a conjunction and ﴿يرى﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by conjunction with (يجزي), if ﴿ليجزي﴾ is attached to ﴿لتأتينكم﴾. (الذين): fāʿil (agent) of (يرى); (أوتوا): passive past verb, and the wāw of the group is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (العلم): second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿أوتوا﴾; the clause ﴿أوتوا العلم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), a clause with no grammatical position. (الذي): first object of (يرى), and the clause ﴿أُنزل﴾ is the ṣila of (الذي), a clause with no grammatical position. (إليك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنزل); (من ربك): a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to (أنزل); (هو): a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position; (الحق): second object of (يرى); and the clause ﴿ويرى الذين أوتوا...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ويهدي إلى صراط العزيز الحميد﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (يهدي): conjoined to ﴿الحق﴾, the verb being conjoined to the noun because it has the sense of one. Or the wāw is circumstantial and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿الذي أنزل﴾, with an implied mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "and it guides" (وهو يهدي). Or the wāw is resumptive. The fāʿil (agent) of (يهدي) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to ﴿الذي أنزل﴾; (إلى صراط): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يهدي); (العزيز): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الحميد): an adjective.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿وقال الذين كفروا هل ندلكم على رجل ينبئكم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (قال): past verb; (الذين): fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), a clause with no grammatical position. (هل): interrogative particle; (ندلكم): imperfect verb, latent (mustatir) agent and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (على رجل): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ندلكم﴾; and the clause ﴿ينبئكم﴾ is an adjective of (رجل).
﴿إذا مزقتم كل ممزق﴾: (إذا): an adverb of future time attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted, the implied form being "you will be resurrected and requited at the time of your being torn apart." (مزقتم): passive past verb, the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the mīm is the sign of the plural. (كل): standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb). (ممزق): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause ﴿إذا مزقتم كل ممزق﴾ is parenthetical, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿إنكم لفي خلق جديد﴾: (إنكم): (إن) is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters) and ﴿كم﴾ is its noun; the lām is the emphasising shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿في خلق﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of (إن); (جديد): an adjective; and the clause ﴿إنكم لفي خلق جديد﴾ stands in place of the second and third objects of the verb (ينبئكم).

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿أفترى على الله كذبا أم به جنة﴾: the hamza is interrogative; (افترى): past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); (على الله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (افترى); ﴿كذبا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb (افترى), i.e. "he fabricated and invented a lie," or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "he fabricated for the sake of lying," or a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "he fabricated while being a liar," and it is an emphasising ḥāl. (أم): a conjunction counterbalancing the interrogative hamza; (به): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (جنة): postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿بل الذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة في العذاب والضلال البعيد﴾: (بل): a particle of conjunction and of digression (iḍrāb); (الذين): mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿لا يؤمنون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), a clause with no grammatical position. (بالآخرة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يؤمنون﴾; (في العذاب): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; (الضلال): conjoined to (العذاب); (البعيد): naʿt (adjective) of (الضلال).

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿أفلم يروا إلى ما بين أيديهم وما خلفهم من السماء والأرض﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. The hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval; the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted, i.e. "Have they become blind, so that they do not see?" (لم): a particle of negation, inversion [of tense] and the jussive; (يروا): imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لم), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw of the group is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿إلى ما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يروا﴾; (بين): an adverb attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. (أيديهم): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (وما خلفهم): conjoined to ﴿ما بين أيديهم﴾; (من السماء): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the two relative nouns; (الأرض): conjoined to (السماء).
﴿إن نشأ نخسف بهم الأرض أو نسقط عليهم كسفا من السماء﴾: (إن): conditional; (نشأ): the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); (نخسف): the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), an imperfect verb, jussive; (بهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نخسف); (الأرض): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (أو): conjunction; (نسقط): conjoined to (نخسف); (عليهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نسقط); (كسفًا): mafʿūl bihi; (من السماء): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿كسفًا﴾.
﴿إن في ذلك لآية لكل عبد منيب﴾: (إن): an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); (في ذلك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of (إن); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); (آية): the postponed noun of (إن); (لكل): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of (آية); (عبد): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (منيب): an adjective of (عبد).

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿ولقد آتينا داود منا فضلا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the lām is in response to an implied oath; (قد): particle of verification; (آتينا): past verb and agent; (داود): first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (منا): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (آتينا) or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿فضلا﴾; (فضلا): second mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ﴿ولقد آتينا داود...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿يا جبال أوبي معه والطير﴾: the vocative clause is the object of an omitted saying, which is either a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "Our saying: O mountains," in which case it is a badal (substitute) from ﴿فضلا﴾, or a verb, i.e. "We said: O mountains," in which case it is a badal from ﴿آتينا﴾. (يا): vocative particle; (جبال): the one addressed, an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative; (أوبي): imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the yāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); (معه): an adverb attached to ﴿أوبي﴾, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الطير): conjoined to the position of (جبال), accusative (manṣūb).
﴿وألنا له الحديد﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (ألنّا): past verb and agent; (له): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ألنا﴾; (الحديد): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause ﴿ألنّا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿آتينا﴾.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿أن اعمل سابغات وقدر في السرد﴾: (أن): maṣdar-forming, on the basis of the dropping of the preposition, i.e. "We softened iron for him for making full coats of mail," or "and We commanded him to make full coats of mail"; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن اعمل﴾ is accusative by removal of the preposition. (سابغات): an adjective of an omitted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e. "full coats of mail" (دروعًا سابغات). (قدِّر): imperative verb; (في السرد): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قدر﴾.
﴿واعملوا صالحا إني بما تعملون بصير﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (اعملوا): imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw of the group is the fāʿil (agent); (صالحا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "do righteous work" (اعملوا عملا صالحا). (إنِّي): (إن) is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and the yāʾ is its noun; (بما): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿بصير﴾, and the clause ﴿تعملون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position. (بصير): khabar (predicate) of (إن).

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿ولسليمان الريح غدوها شهر ورواحها شهر﴾: the wāw is resumptive or a conjunction; (لسليمان): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, i.e. "and We subjected the wind to Solomon" (وسخرنا لسليمان الريح). (الريح): object of the omitted verb; the clause ﴿ولسليمان الريح﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position, or conjoined; the clause ﴿غدوها شهر﴾, made up of mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from (الريح); and the clause ﴿رواحها شهر﴾, made up of mubtadaʾ and khabar, is conjoined to the clause ﴿غدوها شهر﴾, in the position of the accusative.
﴿وأسلنا له عين القطر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause ﴿أسلنا﴾ is conjoined to the implied ﴿سخرنا﴾; (أسلنا): past verb and agent; (له): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أسلنا﴾; (عين): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (القطر): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ومن الجن من يعمل بين يديه بإذن ربه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (من الجن): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied verb, or a fronted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "and We subjected to him, from the jinn, those who work." (مَن): a relative noun in the position of the accusative by the implied verb. Or they are attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), so that the relative noun ﴿مَن﴾ is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause ﴿يعمل﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, a clause with no grammatical position. (بين): an adverb attached to (يعمل); (يديه): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (بإذن): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from the agent of (يعمل); (ربه): muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ومن يزغ منهم عن أمرنا نذقه من عذاب السعير﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (من): a conditional noun governing the jussive, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (يزغ): the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); (منهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent of (يزغ); (عن أمرنا): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يزغ﴾; (نذقه): the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), an imperfect verb, jussive, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; (من عذاب): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نذقه); (السعير): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿يعملون له ما يشاء من محاريب وتماثيل وجفان كالجواب وقدور راسيات﴾: the clause is a badal (substitute) from ﴿يعمل﴾ in the previous ayah. (له): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يعملون); (ما): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position. (من محاريب): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the omitted object of (يشاء), i.e. "what He wills it" (ما يشاؤه). (تماثيل): conjoined to (محاريب); (جفان): also conjoined; (كالجواب): the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the genitive as an adjective of ﴿جفان﴾, and ﴿الجواب﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (قدور): also conjoined; (راسيات): an adjective of ﴿قدور﴾.
﴿اعملوا آل داود شكرا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (اعملوا): imperative verb and agent; (آل): the one addressed, accusative (manṣūb), with the vocative particle omitted; (داود): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (شكرًا): mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), or a maṣdar (verbal noun) from the meaning of (اعملوا), as though it were said: "give thanks by your work" or "do the work of thanks"; or a maṣdar in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "work, being thankful"; or a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) made accusative by (اعملوا).
﴿وقليل من عبادي الشكور﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; (قليل): fronted khabar (predicate); (من عبادي): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of (قليل); (الشكور): postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿فلما قضينا عليه الموت ما دلهم على موته إلا دابة الأرض تأكل منسأته﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; (لما): an adverb of time (ẓarfiyya ḥīniyya) containing the sense of a condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿دلهم﴾; the clause ﴿قضينا﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (قضينا): past verb and agent; (عليه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (قضينا); (الموت): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (ما): negating; (دلهم): past verb, and the pronoun is mafʿūl bihi; (على موته): a preposition, its genitive noun and a muḍāf ilayhi, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿دلهم﴾; (إلا): particle of restriction; (دابة): fāʿil (agent) of (دلهم); (الأرض): muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿ما دلهم ...﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the response to (لما); (تأكل منسأته): verb, latent (mustatir) agent and mafʿūl bihi, and the clause ﴿تأكل منسأته﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from (دابة الأرض); and the clause ﴿فلما قضينا...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿فلما خر تبينت الجن أن لو كانوا يعلمون الغيب ما لبثوا في العذاب المهين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (لما): an adverb of time containing the sense of a condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تبينت﴾; (خر): past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو), and the clause ﴿خر﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿تبينت الجن﴾ is the response to (لما), with no grammatical position; (الجن): fāʿil of (تبينت); (أن): lightened from the heavy form, and its noun is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); (لو): conditional; (كانوا): (كان) is an incomplete past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), and the wāw of the group is its noun; the clause ﴿يعلمون الغيب﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (كان); (ما): negating; the clause ﴿ما لبثوا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the response to (لو); (في العذاب): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿لبثوا﴾; (المهين): an adjective of (العذاب); the clause ﴿لو كانوا ...﴾ is the khabar of the lightened (أن); and the clause ﴿أن لو كانوا...﴾ is an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative as the object of (تبينت) in the sense of "came to know," i.e. "the jinn came to know their ignorance"; or nominative as a badal (substitute) from (الجن) or from something omitted, i.e. "the affair of the jinn became clear, that if…", in which case (تبين) means "became manifest."

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿لقد كان لسبأ في مسكنهم آية﴾: the lām is in response to an implied oath; (قد): particle of verification; (كان): an incomplete past verb (one of kāna and its sisters); (لسبأ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of (كان); (في مسكنهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from (آية); and (آية) is the postponed noun of (كان).
﴿جنتان عن يمين وشمال﴾: (جنتان): badal (substitute) from (آية); (عن يمين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of ﴿جنتان﴾; (شمال): conjoined to (يمين).
﴿كلوا من رزق ربكم واشكروا له﴾: the clause is the object of an omitted saying. (كلوا): imperative verb and agent; (من رزق): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كلوا); (ربكم): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (اشكروا): conjoined to (كلوا); (له): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اشكروا﴾.
﴿بلدة طيبة ورب غفور﴾: (بلدة): khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "it" (هي); (طيبة): an adjective of ﴿بلدة﴾; (رب): khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "He" (هو); (غفور): an adjective of ﴿رب﴾; the clause ﴿بلدة طيبة﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), and the clause ﴿ورب غفور﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿بلدة طيبة﴾.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿فأعرضوا فأرسلنا عليهم سيل العرم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (أعرضوا): past verb and agent, and what it attaches to is omitted, i.e. "they turned away from thanking Him." (فأرسلنا): conjoined to (فأعرضوا); (عليهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أرسلنا); (سيل): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (العرم): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وبدلناهم بجنتيهم جنتين ذواتي أكل خمط وأثل وشيء من سدر قليل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (بدلناهم): conjoined to (أرسلنا); (بدلناهم): past verb, agent and first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (بجنتيهم): a preposition, its genitive noun and a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) (بدلناهم); (جنتين): second mafʿūl bihi; (ذواتي): an adjective of (جنتين); (أكل): muḍāf ilayhi; (خمط): an adjective of ﴿أكل﴾ or a badal (substitute) from it; (أثل): conjoined to (أكل); (شيء): also conjoined; (من سدر): an adjective of (شيء); (قليل): a second adjective of (شيء).

muyesser-irab:17-17.t: ﴿ذلك جزيناهم بما كفروا وهل نجازي إلا الكفور﴾: (ذلك): the second object of (جزيناهم), placed before it, i.e. "We requited them with that exchange." (جزيناهم): past verb, agent and first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); in ﴿بما كفروا﴾ the bāʾ is causal and (ما) is maṣdar-forming, i.e. "because of their disbelief," the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) (جزيناهم). (هل): an interrogative particle in the sense of negation; (نجازي): imperfect verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "We" (نحن); (إلا): particle of restriction; (الكفور): mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿وجعلنا بينهم وبين القرى التي باركنا فيها قرى ظاهرة وقدرنا فيها السير﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (جعلنا): verb and agent; (بينهم): the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿جعلنا﴾, the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the mīm is the sign of the plural; (بين القرى): conjoined to (بينهم); (التي): an adjective of (القرى), and the clause ﴿باركنا فيها﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun ﴿التي﴾, a clause with no grammatical position. (قرى): first mafʿūl bihi; (ظاهرة): naʿt (adjective); the clause ﴿جعلنا﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿جزيناهم﴾; (قدرنا): also conjoined; (قدرنا): past verb and agent; (فيها): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (قدرنا) or to (السير); (السير): mafʿūl bihi.
﴿سيروا فيها ليالي وأياما آمنين﴾: (سيروا): imperative verb, and the wāw of the group is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿سيروا﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the object of an omitted saying; (فيها): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (سيروا); (ليالي): an adverb of time attached to (سيروا); (أيامًا): conjoined to (ليالي); (آمنين): ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent of (سيروا).

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿فقالوا ربنا باعد بين أسفارنا وظلموا أنفسهم فجعلناهم أحاديث ومزقناهم كل ممزق﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (قالوا): verb and agent; (ربنا): the one addressed, accusative (manṣūb), ﴿نا﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the vocative particle is omitted; (باعد): a verb of supplication; (بين): an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿باعد﴾; (أسفارنا): muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿ظلموا﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿قالوا﴾; (ظلموا): verb and agent; (أنفسهم): mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (فجعلناهم): conjoined to ﴿ظلموا أنفسهم﴾; (جعلناهم): verb, agent and first mafʿūl bihi; (أحاديث): second mafʿūl bihi of (جعلناهم); (مزقناهم): conjoined to (جعلناهم); (كل): standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative. (ممزق): muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿إن في ذلك لآيات لكل صبار شكور﴾: (إن): an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); (في ذلك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of (إن); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); (آيات): the postponed noun of (إن); (لكل): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of (آيات); (صبار): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (شكور): an adjective of (صبار).

muyesser-irab:20-20.t: ﴿ولقد صدق عليهم إبليس ظنه فاتبعوه إلا فريقا من المؤمنين﴾: the wāw conjoins to what preceded, or is resumptive; the lām is in response to an implied oath; (قد): particle of verification; (صدق): past verb; (عليهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (صدق); (إبليس): fāʿil (agent); (ظنه): object of (صدق), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause ﴿ولقد صدق...﴾ is conjoined, or resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. (فاتبعوه): the fāʾ is a conjunction; (اتبعوه): past verb, agent and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (إلا): particle of exception; (فريقًا): excepted (mustathnā); (من المؤمنين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿فريقًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿وما كان له عليهم من سلطان﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (ما): negating; (كان): an incomplete past verb (one of kāna and its sisters); (له): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of (كان); (عليهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿سلطان﴾, because it was a naʿt (adjective) of it and was placed before it; (من): a connective (ṣila) preposition; (سلطان): genitive in form, the postponed noun of (كان), nominative in position.
﴿إلا لنعلم من يؤمن بالآخرة ممن هو منها في شك﴾: (إلا): particle of restriction; the lām is for causation or for consequence; (نعلم): imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) (أن) after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the lām and its genitive are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سلطان﴾. (مَن): interrogative, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿يؤمن بالآخرة﴾ is the khabar (predicate). Or ﴿مَن﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as the object of (نعلم), and the clause ﴿يؤمن بالآخرة﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, a clause with no grammatical position. (بالآخرة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يؤمن). (ممن): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نعلم﴾; (هو): mubtadaʾ; (منها): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿شك﴾; (في شك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of (هو).
﴿وربك على كل شيء حفيظ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (ربك): mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (على كل شيء): a preposition, its genitive noun and a muḍāf ilayhi, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حفيظ﴾; (حفيظ): khabar (predicate) of (ربك); and the clause ﴿وربك...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿قل ادعوا الذين زعمتم من دون الله﴾: (قل): imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); the clause ﴿ادعوا الذين﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the accusative; the clause ﴿زعمتم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), a clause with no grammatical position. (من دون): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of the omitted second object; the first object is also omitted, the implied wording being "you claimed them to be gods" (زعمتموهم آلهة); and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿لا يملكون مثقال ذرة في السماوات ولا في الأرض﴾: the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿الذين﴾, or resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. (لا): negating; (يملكون): imperfect verb and agent; (مثقال): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (ذرة): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (في السماوات): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿مثقال ذرة﴾ or a ḥāl from it; (ولا في الأرض): conjoined to ﴿في السماوات﴾.
﴿وما لهم فيهما من شرك وما له منهم من ظهير﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (ما): negating; (لهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (فيهما): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿شرك﴾; (من): a connective (ṣila) preposition; (شرك): genitive in form, nominative in position as the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). The wāw is also a conjunction; (ما): negating; (له): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (منهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from ﴿ظهير﴾; (من): a connective preposition; (ظهير): genitive in form, nominative in position as the postponed mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿ولا تنفع الشفاعة عنده إلا لمن أذن له﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (لا): negating; (تنفع): imperfect verb; (الشفاعة): fāʿil (agent); (عنده): an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from (الشفاعة), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إلا): particle of restriction; (لمن): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (الشفاعة); (أذن): past verb, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), referring to Allah; (له): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أذن).
﴿حتى إذا فزع عن قلوبهم﴾: (حتى): a particle of limit and of the genitive; (إذا): an adverb containing the sense of a condition; (فزع): passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عن قلوبهم﴾.
﴿قالوا ماذا قال ربكم﴾: (قالوا): verb and agent; (ما): an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); (ذا): a relative noun, khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; (قال): past verb; (ربكم): fāʿil (agent); and the clause ﴿قال ربكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun ﴿ذا﴾, a clause with no grammatical position. Or ﴿ماذا﴾ is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as the fronted object of ﴿قال﴾, and ﴿قال ربكم﴾ is a past verb and agent, the kāf being muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause ﴿ماذا قال ربكم﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ is the response to ﴿إذا﴾.
﴿قالوا الحق﴾: (قالوا): verb and agent; (الحق): standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. "they said: our Lord said the true saying" (قال ربُّنا القولَ الحقَ), or it is likewise the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, the implied form being "He said the truth" (قالَ الحقَّ).
﴿وهو العلي الكبير﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿هو﴾ is mubtadaʾ (subject); (العلي): first khabar (predicate); (الكبير): second khabar; and the clause ﴿وهو العلي الكبير﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿قل من يرزقكم من السماوات والأرض قل الله﴾: (قل): imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to the Messenger ﷺ. (من): an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿يرزقكم﴾ is the khabar (predicate); (من السماوات): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يرزقكم﴾; (الأرض): conjoined to (السماوات); (قل): imperative verb; (الله): mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "Allah provides for you" (الله يرزقكم), or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "He is Allah" (هو الله).
﴿وإنا أو إياكم لعلى هدى أو في ضلال مبين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إنّا): ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is the noun of (إن); (أو): conjunction; (إياكم): a detached pronoun conjoined to the noun of (إن); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); (على هدى): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of (إن); (أو): conjunction; (في ضلال): conjoined to His saying ﴿لعلى هدى﴾; (مبين): an adjective.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t: ﴿قل لا تسألون عما أجرمنا ولا نسأل عما تعملون﴾: (قل): imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to the Messenger ﷺ. (لا): negating; (تسألون): passive imperfect verb, and the wāw of the group is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (عما): ﴿عن﴾ is a preposition and ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the genitive, i.e. "about that which we committed"; or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the maṣdar-forming ﴿ما﴾ and the verb ﴿أجرمنا﴾ is genitive by ﴿عن﴾, i.e. "about our committing crimes." (أجرمنا): verb and agent; the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عما أجرمنا﴾ are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تسألون﴾, and the clause ﴿أجرمنا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position. (ولا نسأل): conjoined to ﴿لا تسألون﴾; (نُسأل): passive imperfect verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "we" (نحن); (عما): ﴿عن﴾ is a preposition and ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the genitive, i.e. "about that which you do"; or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming, and the interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdar-forming ﴿ما﴾ and the verb ﴿تعملون﴾ is genitive by ﴿عن﴾, i.e. "about your deeds," the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿نسأل﴾. (تعملون): imperfect verb, and the wāw of the group is the fāʿil; and the clause ﴿تعملون﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t: ﴿قل يجمع بيننا ربنا ثم يفتح بيننا بالحق وهو الفتاح العليم﴾: (قل): imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت), referring to the Messenger ﷺ. The clause ﴿يجمع ...﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); (بيننا): an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يجمع﴾, and the pronoun ﴿نا﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (ربنا): fāʿil of (يجمع), and the pronoun ﴿نا﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; (ثم): conjunction; (يفتح بيننا): conjoined to ﴿يجمع بيننا﴾; (بالحق): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (هو): mubtadaʾ (subject); (الفتاح): first khabar (predicate); (العليم): second khabar.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿قل أروني الذين ألحقتم به شركاء﴾: (قل): imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت), referring to the Messenger ﷺ. (أروني): imperative verb; the wāw of the group is the fāʿil, the nūn is the nūn of protection (al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (الذين): a relative noun, second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿أروني﴾, and the clause ﴿ألحقتم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), a clause with no grammatical position. The resumptive pronoun is omitted, i.e. "you attached them" (ألحقتموهم). (به): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ألحقتم); (شركاء): third mafʿūl bihi of ﴿أروني﴾, that being the case if the "seeing" is cognitive. If the "seeing" is visual, then the verb is made transitive by the hamza, the first object is the yāʾ of the speaker, the second object is the relative, and (شركاءَ) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the omitted resumptive pronoun of the relative. The clause ﴿أروني ...﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿كلا بل هو الله العزيز الحكيم﴾: (كلا): a particle of deterrence and rebuke; (بل): a particle of digression (iḍrāb); (هو): the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (الله): second mubtadaʾ; (العزيز): khabar (predicate) of the Name of Majesty; (الحكيم): second khabar of the Name of Majesty; and the clause ﴿الله العزيز الحكيم﴾ is the khabar of (هو). Or ﴿هو﴾ is mubtadaʾ, the pronoun referring to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, ﴿الله﴾ is the khabar, and (العزيز الحكيم) are two adjectives.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿وما أرسلناك إلا كافة للناس بشيرا ونذيرا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (ما): negating; (أرسلناك): past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (إلا): particle of restriction; (كافة): ḥāl (circumstantial) from (الناس), i.e. "to all the people" (للناس كافة); or a ḥāl from the object of (أرسلناك), the tāʾ marbūṭa being for intensification, i.e. "except as one who gathers all people in conveying [the message]"; or an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "a sending that encompasses the people" (إرسالةً كافةً للناس). (للناس): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسلنا﴾; (بشيرًا): ḥāl from the object of (أرسلناك); (نذيرًا): conjoined to (بشيرا); and the clause ﴿وما أرسلناك...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ولكن أكثر الناس لا يعلمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لكنَّ): an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); (أكثر): noun of (لكن); (الناس): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (لا): negating; (يعلمون): imperfect verb, and the wāw of the group is the fāʿil (agent); and the clause ﴿لا يعلمون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (لكن).

muyesser-irab:29-29.t: ﴿ويقولون متى هذا الوعد إن كنتم صادقين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (يقولون): imperfect verb, and the wāw of the group is the fāʿil (agent); (متى): an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as an adverb, and this adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (هذا): postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); (الوعد): badal (substitute); the clause ﴿ويقولون متى هذا الوعد﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. (إن): conditional; (كنتم): an incomplete past verb (one of kāna and its sisters) in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the tāʾ is its noun, and the mīm is the sign of the plural. (صادقين): khabar of (كنتم); and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t: ﴿قل لكم ميعاد يوم لا تستأخرون عنه ساعة ولا تستقدمون﴾: (قل): imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); (لكم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (ميعاد): postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); (يوم): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿لا تستأخرون﴾ is an adjective of ﴿يوم﴾ or of ﴿ميعاد﴾; (عنه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تستأخرون﴾; (ساعة): an adverb, also attached to ﴿تستأخرون﴾; (ولا تستقدمون): conjoined to ﴿لا تستأخرون﴾.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿وقال الذين كفروا لن نؤمن بهذا القرآن ولا بالذي بين يديه﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (قال): past verb; (الذين): a relative noun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذي) [Translator's note: the source writes the singular الذي here, though the relative in the ayah is الذين], a clause with no grammatical position. (لن): a particle of negation, the accusative and the future; (نؤمن): imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by (لن); ﴿بهذا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نؤمن); (القرآن): badal (substitute); (ولا): the wāw is a conjunction and ﴿لا﴾ is for emphasising the negation; (بالذي): conjoined to ﴿بهذا القرآن﴾; (بين): an adverb attached to the omitted ṣila of (الذي), and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. (يديه): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿لن نؤمن ...﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); and the clause ﴿وقال الذين كفروا...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ولو ترى إذ الظالمون موقوفون عند ربهم يرجع بعضهم إلى بعض القول﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (لو): conditional; (ترى): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (إذ): a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿ترى﴾; (الظالمون): mubtadaʾ (subject); (موقوفون): khabar (predicate); (عند): an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿موقوفون﴾; (ربهم): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿يرجع﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun of ﴿موقوفون﴾; (بعضهم): fāʿil; (إلى بعض): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يرجع﴾; (القول): mafʿūl bihi of (يرجع); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "you would have seen something astonishing" or "you would have seen a hideous state"; and the clause ﴿ولو ترى...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿يقول الذين استضعفوا للذين استكبروا لولا أنتم لكنا مؤمنين﴾: (يقول): imperfect verb; (الذين): fāʿil (agent) of (يقول), and the clause ﴿استضعفوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), a clause with no grammatical position. (للذين): ﴿اللام﴾ is a preposition and ﴿الذين﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the genitive, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يقول﴾, and the clause ﴿استكبروا﴾ is the ṣila of (الذين), a clause with no grammatical position. (لولا): a particle of non-occurrence due to existence; (أنتم): mubtadaʾ (subject), and the khabar (predicate) is necessarily omitted, its implied form being "existing" (موجودون); the lām links the apodosis of (لولا); (كنا): an incomplete verb (one of kāna and its sisters), ﴿نا﴾ is the noun of (كان), and (مؤمنين) is the khabar of (كان); the clause ﴿لكنا مؤمنين﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a condition that does not govern the jussive; the clause ﴿لولا أنتم لكنا مؤمنين﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); and the clause ﴿يقول الذين ...﴾ is a resumption explaining that exchange, with no grammatical position, or a badal (substitute) from ﴿يرجع بعضهم ...﴾.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿قال الذين استكبروا للذين استضعفوا﴾: the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. (قال): past verb; (الذين): a relative noun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿استكبروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), a clause with no grammatical position. (للذين): ﴿اللام﴾ is a preposition and ﴿الذين﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the genitive, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾; (استضعفوا): passive past verb, and the wāw of the group is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause ﴿استضعفوا﴾ is the ṣila of (الذين), a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿أنحن صددناكم عن الهدى بعد إذ جاءكم بل كنتم مجرمين﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval; (نحن): mubtadaʾ (subject); (صددناكم): past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿صددناكم﴾ is the khabar (predicate); (عن الهدى): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (صددناكم); (بعد): an adverb attached to ﴿صددناكم﴾; (إذ): a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e. "after the time of its coming"; the clause ﴿جاءكم﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (بل): a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction; (كنتم): the incomplete ﴿كان﴾ (one of kāna and its sisters), the tāʾ is its noun, and (مجرمين) is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿وقال الذين استضعفوا للذين استكبروا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (قال): past verb; (الذين): fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿استضعفوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), a clause with no grammatical position; (استضعفوا): passive past verb; (للذين): the lām is a preposition and ﴿الذين﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the genitive, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾; and the clause ﴿استكبروا﴾ is the ṣila of (الذين), a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿بل مكر الليل والنهار﴾: (بل): a particle of digression (iḍrāb); (مكر): mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "the plotting of night and day barred us," or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "the cause of our disbelief is the plotting of night and day." (الليل): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (النهار): conjoined to (الليل).
﴿إذ تأمروننا أن نكفر بالله ونجعل له أندادا﴾: (إذ): a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive as a badal (substitute) from (الليل والنهار), or an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مكر﴾; the clause ﴿تأمروننا﴾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation; (أن): maṣdar-forming; (نكفر): imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by (أن); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن نكفر﴾ is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "you commanded us to disbelief" (تأمروننا بالكفر), the omitted preposition and what it governs being attached to ﴿تأمروننا﴾; (بالله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نكفر﴾; (نجعل): conjoined to (نكفر); (له): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿أندادا﴾; (أندادًا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object). Or the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿له﴾ are attached to the second object of ﴿نجعل﴾, and ﴿أندادًا﴾ is the first object of (نجعل).
﴿وأسروا الندامة لما رأوا العذاب﴾: the wāw is circumstantial or resumptive; (أسروا): verb and agent; (الندامة): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (لما): an adverb of time (ẓarfiyya ḥīniyya) attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أسروا﴾, and the clause ﴿رأوا﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; (العذاب): mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ﴿وأسروا الندامة﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وجعلنا الأغلال في أعناق الذين كفروا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (جعلنا): verb and agent; (الأغلال): first object of (جعلنا); (في أعناق): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of (جعلنا); (الذين): a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿هل يجزون إلا ما كانوا يعملون﴾: the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from (الذين كفروا). (هل): an interrogative particle, the interrogative being in the sense of negation; (يجزون): passive imperfect verb, and the wāw of the group is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (إلا): particle of restriction; (ما): second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of (يجزون); (كانوا): (كان) is an incomplete past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), and the wāw of the group is its noun; the clause ﴿يعملون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (كان); and the clause ﴿كانوا يعملون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿وما أرسلنا في قرية من نذير إلا قال مترفوها﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (ما): negating; (أرسلنا): verb and agent; (في قرية): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسلنا﴾; (من): a connective (ṣila) preposition; (نذير): genitive in form, accusative in position as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (إلا): particle of restriction; the clause ﴿قال مترفوها﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿قرية﴾, even though it is indefinite, because it is in a context of negation; (مترفوها): fāʿil (agent) of (قال).
﴿إنا بما أرسلتم به كافرون﴾: the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the accusative. (إنّا): ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; (بما): the bāʾ is a preposition and ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the genitive, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كافرون); the clause ﴿أرسلتم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, a clause with no grammatical position. (أرسلتم): passive past verb, the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the mīm is the sign of the plural; (به): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أرسلتم﴾; (كافرون): khabar (predicate) of (إن).

muyesser-irab:35-35.t: ﴿وقالوا نحن أكثر أموالا وأولادا وما نحن بمعذبين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (قالوا): verb and agent; (نحن): mubtadaʾ (subject); (أكثر): khabar (predicate); (أموالا): tamyīz (specification); (أولادًا): conjoined to ﴿أموالا﴾; (ما): the Ḥijāzī negating (ما), operating like (ليس); (نحن): noun of (ما); the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition; (معذبين): khabar of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position, genitive in form by the bāʾ; and the clause ﴿نحن أكثر أموالا ...﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿قل إن ربي يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء ويقدر﴾: (قل): imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); (إن): an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); (ربي): noun of (إن); the clause ﴿يبسط الرزق﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (إن); (لمن): the lām is a preposition and ﴿مَن﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the genitive, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يبسط﴾, and the clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, a clause with no grammatical position. (يقدر): conjoined to (يبسط); and the clause ﴿إن ربي يبسط ...﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿ولكن أكثر الناس لا يعلمون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, or a conjunction, the clause ﴿ولكن أثر﴾ [Translator's note: thus in the source, a slip for ﴿ولكن أكثر﴾] being conjoined to the clause ﴿إن ربي يبسط ...﴾; (لكن): abrogating, one of the sisters of (إن); (أكثر): noun of (لكن); the clause ﴿لا يعلمون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (لكن); and the object of (يعلمون) is omitted, indicated by the context.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿وما أموالكم ولا أولادكم بالتي تقربكم عندنا زلفى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or resumptive; (ما): the Ḥijāzī negating (ما), operating like (ليس); (أموالكم): noun of (ليس) [Translator's note: thus in the source; it is the noun of (ما), which operates like (ليس)], and the attached pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the wāw is a conjunction; (لا): for emphasising the negation; His saying ﴿ولا أولادكم﴾ is conjoined to (أموالكم); in ﴿بالتي﴾ the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and (التي) is a relative noun, accusative in position as the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾ and genitive in form by the bāʾ; the clause ﴿تقربكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿التي﴾, a clause with no grammatical position. (عندنا): an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿زلفى﴾; (زلفى): standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) according to the meaning, because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) from the meaning of the governing word, i.e. "bring you near a nearness" (تقربكم قربة).
﴿إلا من آمن وعمل صالحا﴾: ﴿إلا﴾ means "but" (لكن), and the exception is disconnected (munqaṭiʿ); (مَن): a relative noun, a disconnected excepted (mustathnā munqaṭiʿ) in the position of the accusative. Or the exception is connected (muttaṣil), and ﴿مَن﴾ is excepted from the object in (يقربكم). Or ﴿مَن﴾ is mubtadaʾ (subject) and the clause ﴿فأولئك لهم جزاء الضعف﴾ is the khabar (predicate). The clause ﴿آمن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, a clause with no grammatical position. (عمل): conjoined to (آمن); (صالحًا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿عمل﴾, or standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "did righteous work" (عمل عملًا صالحًا).
﴿فأولئك لهم جزاء الضعف بما عملوا﴾: the fāʾ is linking, because of the sense of condition in the relative; (أولئك): a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); (لهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (جزاء): postponed mubtadaʾ, and ﴿جزاء﴾ is muḍāf; (الضعف): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿لهم جزاء الضعف﴾ is the khabar of (أولئك); (بما): the bāʾ is a preposition, and ﴿ما﴾ is relative or maṣdar-forming; the clause ﴿عملوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position. The bāʾ of the genitive and what it governs are attached to (جزاء).
﴿وهم في الغرفات آمنون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (هم): mubtadaʾ (subject); (في الغرفات): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or attached to ﴿آمنون﴾; (آمنون): khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t: ﴿والذين يسعون في آياتنا معاجزين أولئك في العذاب محضرون﴾: الواو: a conjunction, conjoining to what preceded; والذين: a relative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يسعون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), a clause with no grammatical position. وفي آياتنا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يسعون﴾; ومعاجزين: ḥāl (circumstantial); وأولئك: a demonstrative, a second mubtadaʾ; وفي العذاب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿محضرون﴾; ومحضرون: the khabar (predicate) of the second mubtadaʾ ﴿أولئك﴾; and the clause ﴿أولئك في العذاب محضرون﴾ is the khabar of الذين.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿قل إن ربي يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء من عباده ويقدر له﴾: قل: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت"; وإن: an abrogating particle; وربي: the noun of إن, and the yāʾ of the speaker is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿يبسط الرزق﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن; ولمن: the lām is a preposition and ﴿مَن﴾ is a relative noun in the position of genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يبسط﴾; the clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, a clause with no grammatical position. The resumptive pronoun is omitted, and it is the object of يشاء, i.e. "لمن يشاؤه"; ومن عباده: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the omitted resumptive pronoun; ويقدر: conjoined to يبسط; وله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يقدر﴾; and the clause ﴿إن ربي يبسط ...﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿وما أنفقتم من شيء فهو يخلفه﴾: الواو: a conjunction; وما: conditional, in the position of accusative as a fronted object of ﴿أنفقتم﴾; and ﴿أنفقتم﴾ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ومن شيء: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of ﴿ما﴾; والفاء: linking the apodosis; وهو: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يخلفه﴾ is the khabar; and the clause ﴿فهو يخلفه﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). Or ﴿ما﴾ is a relative, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿أنفقتم﴾ is the ṣila, a clause with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿فهو يخلفه﴾ is then in the position of nominative as the khabar, and the fāʾ entered the khabar because of the scent of condition in the relative.
﴿وهو خير الرازقين﴾: الواو: a conjunction; وهو: mubtadaʾ; وخير: khabar; والرازقين: muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause ﴿هو خير الرازقين﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿هو يخلفه﴾.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t: ﴿ويوم يحشرهم جميعا ثم يقول للملائكة أهؤلاء إياكم كانوا يعبدون﴾: الواو: resumptive; ويوم: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر"; ويحشرهم: an imperfect verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the mīm is the plural marker; the clause ﴿يحشرهم﴾ is in the position of genitive because the adverb is annexed to it, and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; وجميعًا: ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of يحشرهم; وثم: a conjunction; ويقول: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by conjunction to يحشرهم; وللملائكة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يقول﴾; والهمزة: for the interrogative of rebuke; وهؤلاء: mubtadaʾ (subject); وإياكم: a detached pronoun in the position of accusative as a fronted object of ﴿يعبدون﴾; وكانوا: the defective (nāqiṣa) ﴿كان﴾, and the wāw is its noun; the clause ﴿يعبدون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of كان; and the clause ﴿كانوا يعبدون﴾ is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿قالوا سبحانك أنت ولينا من دونهم﴾: قالوا: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); وسبحانك: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative by an omitted verb, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). وأنت: mubtadaʾ (subject); وولينا: khabar (predicate), and ﴿نا﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; ومن دونهم: a preposition, its genitive noun and a muḍāf ilayhi, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿بل كانوا يعبدون الجن أكثرهم بهم مؤمنون﴾: بل: a particle of digression (iḍrāb); وكانوا: the defective (nāqiṣa) ﴿كان﴾, and the wāw of the plural is its noun; the clause ﴿يعبدون﴾ is the khabar of كان; والجن: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); وأكثرهم: mubtadaʾ, and the pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi; وبهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مؤمنون﴾; ومؤمنون: khabar; and the clause ﴿أكثرهم بهم مؤمنون﴾ is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī), or causal, and has no grammatical position in either case.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿فاليوم لا يملك بعضكم لبعض نفعا ولا ضرا﴾: الفاء: a conjunction for ordering the statements; واليوم: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يملك﴾; ولا: negating; ويملك: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); وبعضكم: fāʿil (agent); ولبعض: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نفعًا﴾; ونفعًا: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ولا ضرًّا: conjoined to ﴿نفعًا﴾.
﴿ونقول للذين ظلموا ذوقوا عذاب النار التي كنتم بها تكذبون﴾: الواو: a conjunction; ونقول: an imperfect verb conjoined to ﴿لا يملك﴾; وللذين: the lām is a preposition and ﴿الذين﴾ is a relative noun in the position of genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿نقول﴾; the clause ﴿ظلموا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), a clause with no grammatical position. وذوقوا: an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the clause ﴿ذوقوا﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); وعذابَ: mafʿūl bihi; والنار: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); والتي: a relative noun, an adjective (ṣifa) of النار; وكنتم: the defective (nāqiṣa) كان, the tāʾ is the noun of كان and the mīm is the plural marker; وبها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تكذبون﴾; the clause ﴿تكذبون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of كنتم; and the clause ﴿كنتم بها تكذبون﴾ is the ṣila of the relative ﴿التي﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿وإذا تتلى عليهم آياتنا بينات قالوا ما هذا إلا رجل يريد أن يصدكم عما كان يعبد آباؤكم﴾: الواو: a conjunction; وإذا: a future adverb containing the sense of condition; وتتلى: an imperfect verb in the passive (lit. built for one whose agent is not named); the clause ﴿تتلى﴾ is in the position of genitive because the adverb is annexed to it; وعليهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تتلى﴾; وآياتنا: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the pronoun ﴿نا﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); وبينات: ḥāl (circumstantial) of آياتنا; the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussivising condition; وما: negating; وهذا: mubtadaʾ (subject), the reference being to the Prophet ﷺ; وإلا: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ورجل: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ ﴿هذا﴾; the clause ﴿يريد﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa) of رجل; وأن: maṣdariyya; ويصدكم: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو", the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the mīm is the plural marker; and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يصدكم﴾ is the object of ﴿يريد﴾; وعما: عن is a preposition and ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يصدكم﴾; وكان: a defective verb, and the noun of كان is latent, its implied form being "هو"; ويعبد: an imperfect verb; وآباؤكم: fāʿil; the clause ﴿يعبد آباؤكم﴾ is the khabar of كان; and the clause ﴿كان يعبد آباؤكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وقالوا ما هذا إلا إفك مفترى﴾: الواو: a conjunction; وقالوا: a verb and its fāʿil; وما: negating; وهذا: mubtadaʾ; وإلا: a particle of restriction; وإفك: khabar; ومفترى: an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿وقال الذين كفروا للحق لما جاءهم إن هذا إلا سحر مبين﴾: الواو: a conjunction; وقال: a past verb; والذين: fāʿil; the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position. وللحق: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قال﴾; ولما: temporal (ẓarfiyya ḥīniyya) or linking; وجاءهم: a verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; وإن: negating; وهذا: mubtadaʾ; وإلا: a particle of restriction; وسحر: the khabar of ﴿هذا﴾; ومبين: an adjective.

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿وما آتيناهم من كتب يدرسونها﴾: الواو: circumstantial (ḥāliyya); وما: negating; وآتيناهم: a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ومِن: a connective (ṣila) preposition; وكتب: genitive (majrūr) in form, accusative (manṣūb) in position, as the second object of آتيناهم; ويدرسونها: an imperfect verb, the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil and ﴿ها﴾ is mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ﴿يدرسونها﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿كتب﴾.
﴿وما أرسلنا إليهم قبلك من نذير﴾: الواو: a conjunction; وما: negating; وأرسلنا: a verb and its fāʿil; وإليهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسلنا﴾; وقبلك: an adverb of time, accusative, attached to ﴿أرسلنا﴾, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ومن: a connective preposition; ونذير: genitive in form, accusative in position, as the object of أرسلنا.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿وكذب الذين من قبلهم وما بلغوا معشار ما آتيناهم﴾: الواو: a conjunction; وكذب: a past verb; والذين: a relative noun in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); ومن قبلهم: a preposition, its genitive noun and a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. وما: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and ﴿ما﴾ is negating; وبلغوا: a verb and its fāʿil; ومعشار: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); وما: a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause ﴿آتيناهم﴾ is the ṣila of the relative ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿فكذبوا رسلي فكيف كان نكير﴾: الفاء: a conjunction; وكذبوا: a verb and its fāʿil; ورسلي: mafʿūl bihi; والفاء: a conjunction; وكيف: an interrogative noun, the fronted khabar (predicate) of ﴿كان﴾; وكان: a defective verb; ونكير: the noun of كان, and the omitted yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause ﴿كيف كان نكير﴾ is conjoined to something omitted, i.e. "فأهلكتهم فكيف كان نكير".

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿قل إنما أعظكم بواحدة أن تقوموا لله مثنى وفرادى﴾: قل: an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت"; وإنما: the restraining (kāffa) mā and the restrained particle (makfūfa); وأعظكم: an imperfect verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); وبواحدة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعظكم﴾; وأن: maṣdariyya; وتقوموا: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن تقوموا﴾ is genitive as ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) to واحدة or a badal (substitute) from it; or nominative as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), on the implied form "هي أن تقوموا"; or accusative on the implied form "أعني". ومثنى: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative; وفرادى: conjoined to مثنى.
﴿ثم تتفكروا ما بصاحبكم من جنة﴾: ثم: a conjunction for sequence with delay; وتتفكروا: a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause ﴿تتفكروا﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿تقوموا﴾; وما: negating; وبصاحبكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; ومن: a connective (ṣila) preposition; وجنة: genitive (majrūr) in form, nominative (marfūʿ) in position as mubtadaʾ; and the clause ﴿ما بصاحبكم ...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿إن هو إلا نذير لكم بين يدي عذاب شديد﴾: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) with no grammatical position. وإن: negating; وهو: mubtadaʾ; وإلا: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ونذير: the khabar of ﴿هو﴾; ولكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿نذير﴾; وبين: an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl or adjective of ﴿نذير﴾; ويدي: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); وعذاب: muḍāf ilayhi; وشديد: an adjective of ﴿عذاب﴾.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿قل ما سألتكم من أجر فهو لكم﴾: قل: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". و﴿ما﴾: conditional, in the position of accusative as the fronted second object of ﴿سألتكم﴾. وسألتكم: a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is the fāʿil, the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the mīm is the plural marker. ومن أجر: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿ما﴾, or a tamyīz (specification). والفاء: linking the apodosis of the condition. وهو: mubtadaʾ (subject). ولكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). And the nominal clause ﴿هو لكم﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). Or ﴿ما﴾ is a relative, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿سألتكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), a clause with no grammatical position. The resumptive pronoun is omitted, i.e. "ما سألتكموه من أجر"; ﴿الفاء﴾ is linking because of the sense of condition in the relative; and the clause ﴿هو لكم﴾ is the khabar.
﴿إن أجري إلا على الله وهو على كل شيء شهيد﴾: a resumption within the scope of the saying. وإن: negating; وأجري: mubtadaʾ, and the yāʾ of the speaker is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). وإلا: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). وعلى الله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; and the clause ﴿إن أجري إلا على الله﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. وهو: mubtadaʾ. وعلى كل: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿شهيد﴾. وشيء: muḍāf ilayhi. وشهيد: the khabar of ﴿هو﴾.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t: ﴿قل إن ربي يقذف بالحق علام الغيوب﴾: قل: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". وإن: an abrogating particle. وربي: the noun of إن. The clause ﴿يقذف﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن. وبالحق: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يقذف﴾. وعلام: a second khabar of ﴿إن﴾. والغيوب: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). And the clause ﴿إن ربي ...﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of accusative.

muyesser-irab:49-49.t: ﴿قل جاء الحق وما يبدئ الباطل وما يعيد﴾: قل: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". وجاء: a past verb. والحق: fāʿil. The clause ﴿جاء الحق﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of accusative. والواو: a conjunction. وما: negating. ويبدئ: an imperfect verb. والباطل: fāʿil; وما يعيد: conjoined to ﴿ما يبدئ﴾.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿قل إن ضللت فإنما أضل على نفسي﴾: قل: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". وإن: conditional. وضللت: a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is the fāʿil. والفاء: linking the apodosis of the condition. وإنما: the restraining (kāffa) mā and the restrained particle (makfūfa). وأضل: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "أنا". وعلى نفسي: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أضل﴾, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). And the apodosis clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of jussive.
﴿وإن اهتديت فبما يوحي إلي ربي﴾: الواو: a conjunction, conjoining to the clause ﴿إن ضللت ...﴾. وإن: conditional. واهتديت: a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil. والفاء: linking the apodosis of the condition. والباء: a preposition. وما: maṣdariyya, i.e. "because of my Lord's revealing to me", or a relative, i.e. "because of that which my Lord reveals to me"; and the bāʾ with its genitive ﴿بما﴾ are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "فاهتدائي بما يوحى إليَّ ربي" [Translator's note: the source writes يوحى here, whereas the ayah reads ﴿يوحي﴾]; and the nominal clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The clause ﴿يوحي﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), a clause with no grammatical position. وإلَيَّ: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يوحي﴾; وربي: the fāʿil of يوحي.
﴿إنه سميع قريب﴾: إنه: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle and the hāʾ is its noun. وسميع: the khabar of إن; وقريب: a second khabar of ﴿إن﴾.

muyesser-irab:51-51.t: ﴿ولو ترى إذ فزعوا فلا فوت وأخذوا من مكان قريب﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position. ولو: conditional. وترى: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت". وإذ: an adverb for past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ترى﴾. The clause ﴿فزعوا﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). The apodosis of ﴿لو﴾ is omitted, just as the object of ترى is omitted; the implied form is: "ولو ترى حالهم وقت فزعهم لرأيت أمرًا عظيمًا" (had you seen their state at the time of their terror, you would have seen a tremendous thing). Or ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of accusative as the object of ﴿ترى﴾, the implied form being "لو ترى ذلك الزمان". والفاء: a conjunction or resumptive. ولا: the lā of generic negation. وفوت: the noun of لا, indeclinable on fatḥa, and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "فلا فوت لهم". The clause ﴿فلا فوت...﴾ is conjoined, or resumptive with no grammatical position. وأخذوا: the wāw is a conjunction, and أخذوا is a past verb in the passive (lit. built for one whose agent is not named), and the wāw of the plural is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ومن مكان: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أخذوا﴾; وقريب: an adjective (ṣifa); and the clause ﴿أخذوا﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿فزعوا﴾, in the position of genitive.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t: ﴿وقالوا آمنا به وأنى لهم التناوش من مكان بعيد﴾: الواو: a conjunction. The clause ﴿قالوا﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿فزعوا﴾. وقالوا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent). The clause ﴿آمنا﴾: the object of their saying (maqūl al-qawl). وبه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿آمنا﴾. ﴿وأنى﴾: the wāw is parenthetical, and أنى is an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as a fronted khabar (predicate), meaning "from where" or "how". ولهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of التناوش. والتناوش: a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject). ومن مكان: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿التناوش﴾. وبعيد: an adjective (ṣifa). And the clause ﴿وأنى لهم التناوش ...﴾ is parenthetical, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:53-53.t: ﴿وقد كفروا به من قبل ويقذفون بالغيب من مكان بعيد﴾: الواو: circumstantial (ḥāliyya). وقد: a particle of realization (taḥqīq). وكفروا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent). وبه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كفروا﴾. ومن قبل: ﴿من﴾ is a preposition and ﴿قبلُ﴾ an adverb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of كفروا. ويقذفون: conjoined to ﴿كفروا﴾ as a narration of a past state (ḥikāyat ḥāl māḍiya), i.e. "and they used to hurl at the unseen". وبالغيب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يقذفون﴾. ومن مكان: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يقذفون﴾. وبعيد: an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:54-54.t:
﴿وحيل بينهم وبين ما يشتهون كما فعل بأشياعهم من قبل﴾: الواو: a conjunction. وحيل: a past verb in the passive (lit. built for one whose agent is not named), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is the pronoun of the maṣdar understood from the verb; the implied form is "وحيل هو", i.e. "وحِيلَ الحولُ بينهم". وبينهم: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حيل﴾, and the pronoun is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). وبين: conjoined to the first adverb. وما: a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, i.e. "and between that which they desire"; or maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿ما يشتهون﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi, i.e. "and between their desire". ويشتهون: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿يشتهون﴾ has no grammatical position. كما: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "a barring was placed between them and what they desire, like that which was done to their kind"; and ما is a relative, muḍāf ilayhi, or maṣdariyya, forming with what follows an interpreted maṣdar that is muḍāf ilayhi. وفُعِل: a past verb in the passive, and the nāʾib fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو", referring back to the maṣdar of the verb. وبأشياعهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿فُعِل﴾, and the pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi. ومن قبل: ﴿من﴾ is a preposition and ﴿قبلُ﴾ an adverb, indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿فُعِل﴾, or to ﴿أشياعهم﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of أشياعهم. And the clause ﴿وحيل بينهم﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿فزعوا﴾.
﴿إنهم كانوا في شك مريب﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. وإنهم: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle and the pronoun is its noun. وكانوا: ﴿كان﴾ is a defective verb and the wāw of the plural is its noun. وفي شك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of كان. ومريب: an adjective of ﴿شك﴾, genitive. And the clause ﴿كانوا في شك﴾ is the khabar of إن.
